name: HC10d: Tested for CRAG
description: Number of new ART clients with baseline CD4 &amp;lt;200 who were tested for Cryptococcal Antigen (CRAG) during the reporting period. The client must have initiated ART during the reporting period, have a documented HIV enrollment date, have started ART within 7 days of HIV enrollment, not be a transfer-in, have a baseline CD4 result below 200 cells/mm³, and have evidence of CRAG testing during the reporting period through a Serum CRAG Screening record, a CRAG test result, or CRAG testing information documented on the HIV ART Card. Each eligible client is counted once.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f

    "extractFrom": "sqlTemplate"

  "sqlTemplate": "SELECT DISTINCT s.client_id AS patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
WHERE s.client_id IS NOT NULL
  AND s.baseline_regimen_start_date >= :startDate
  AND s.baseline_regimen_start_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  AND s.hiv_enrollment_date IS NOT NULL
  AND DATEDIFF(
      s.baseline_regimen_start_date,
      s.hiv_enrollment_date
  ) <= 7
  AND s.transfer_in_regimen_start_date IS NULL
  AND s.baseline_cd4 IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.baseline_cd4) REGEXP '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
  AND CAST(s.baseline_cd4 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) < 200
  AND (
      EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM mamba_fact_test_orders_results r
          WHERE r.patient_id = s.client_id
            AND r.encounter_datetime >= :startDate
            AND r.encounter_datetime < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            AND (
                (
                    r.test_concept_id = 164987
                    AND UPPER(TRIM(r.test_value)) = 'YES'
                )
                OR (
                    r.test_concept_id IN (164986, 165290, 199990)
                    AND UPPER(TRIM(r.test_value)) IN (
                        'POSITIVE',
                        'POS',
                        '+',
                        '(+)',
                        'NEGATIVE',
                        '-',
                        '(-)'
                    )
                )
            )
      )
      OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
          WHERE a.client_id = s.client_id
            AND a.encounter_date >= :startDate
            AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            AND a.crag_test_results IS NOT NULL
            AND TRIM(a.crag_test_results) <> ''
      )
  )",
